title: tc-guardrail-notice
description: Content a policy blocked, redacted or rewrote: which policy, why, what changed – personal data masked – and Request review.

action.description: What the policy did: blocked the content, redacted parts of it or rewrote it – sets the icon, tone and wording

layout.description: Where it sits: "inline" in a thread, where the content would have been, or "banner" across the top of a view

heading.description: The heading – "Blocked by policy", "Redacted by policy" or "Rewritten by policy" by default

policy.description: The policy that acted, by the name people know it by, e.g. "Personal data"

policyHref.description: A link to the policy itself; the policy name becomes the link

reason.description: Why the policy acted, in a sentence

original.description: The content as it was, with personal data already masked by the app – text, or segments

revised.description: The content as it went out – text, or segments; leave it out when nothing went out

revisedLabel.description: The label over what went out – "Shown instead", "After redaction" or "Rewritten" by default

open.description: Whether the before / after is showing

reviewable.description: Offers Request review; set it to false where there is no one to review

requested.description: A review has been requested: the button shows "Review requested" and is off

reviewLabel.description: The label of the review button

requestedLabel.description: What the button says once a review is requested

dismissible.description: Shows a close button that fires tc-dismiss

GuardrailSegment.description: A run of text in the before / after: plain, or marked as removed, added or masked
